description: This is a Java interface for a repository wrapper that handles read operations related to Notification entities within the Fineract notification service. It provides method signatures for finding by ID, fetching all notifications, and deleting notifications by ID.

classes.name: NotificationGeneratorReadRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: An interface defining read operations for Notification entities in the notification service.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Notification by its unique identifier.

methods.name: fetchAllNotifications
methods.description: Fetches a list of all notifications.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a notification with the specified ID.
